name: TPU7x single chiplet
assumptions: Per-chip peak compute and bandwidth are divided equally between two chiplets.
Logical HLO traffic approximates HBM traffic; fusion and reuse are not modeled.
Dot FLOPs use a BF16-equivalent rate; dtype-specific rates are not modeled.
Compute and memory overlap within an execution; executions on one stream are serialized.
Utilization and launch overhead are uncalibrated scenario parameters.
